question: Please generate a summary of the closing balances at the end of each month for each customer transactions, show the monthly changes and monthly cumulative bank account balances. Ensure that even if a customer has no account activity in a given month, the balance for that month is still included in the output.
sql:
WITH all_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
all_months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) as month_year FROM customer_transactions
),
all_combinations AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, m.month_year
    FROM all_customers c
    CROSS JOIN all_months m
),
monthly_transactions_with_running_balance AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, txn_type, txn_amount, 
           SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) as month_year,
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                    WHEN txn_type IN ('withdrawal', 'purchase') THEN -txn_amount 
                    ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) as running_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
),
monthly_last_transaction_date AS (
    SELECT customer_id, month_year, MAX(txn_date) as last_txn_date
    FROM monthly_transactions_with_running_balance
    GROUP BY customer_id, month_year
),
monthly_last_transaction AS (
    SELECT mlt.customer_id, mlt.month_year, mlt.last_txn_date, mtrb.running_balance as closing_balance
    FROM monthly_last_transaction_date mlt
    JOIN monthly_transactions_with_running_balance mtrb 
        ON mlt.customer_id = mtrb.customer_id 
        AND mlt.month_year = mtrb.month_year 
        AND mlt.last_txn_date = mtrb.txn_date
),
monthly_closing AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, month_year, 
           closing_balance
    FROM monthly_last_transaction
),
with_closing_balance AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, c.month_year, 
           COALESCE(mc.closing_balance, LAG(mc.closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_id ORDER BY c.month_year)) as closing_balance
    FROM all_combinations c
    LEFT JOIN monthly_closing mc ON c.customer_id = mc.customer_id AND c.month_year = mc.month_year
),
with_previous_balance AS (
    SELECT customer_id, month_year, closing_balance,
           LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_year) as prev_month_balance
    FROM with_closing_balance
)
